Project Manager – Engineering & Operations

  • Tel Aviv, Israel
  • Full-time
  • Hybrid: Office + Field
  • 2026-08-11

At AGEERA, we don’t just observe the energy transition – we drive it. As a fast-growing Climate-Tech company, we are redefining the modern energy market using advanced AI platforms and utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). We build, manage, and integrate Israel’s next-generation Virtual Power Plant (VPP) and Energy Management System (EMS) infrastructure.

If you are looking for a role where innovation meets execution on the ground, and want to leave a lasting impact on Israel’s smart grid infrastructure – your place is with us.

We are seeking a sharp, highly organized, and execution-oriented Operations Project Manager. In this role, you will lead the operational and logistical execution of battery energy storage system (BESS) construction sites from end-to-end.

You will serve as the crucial link between planning and field execution: building operational work plans, supervising contractors and vendors on-site, tracking timelines, and serving as the right hand to the Planning, Construction & Operations Manager.

At AGEERA, we don’t just keep up with the energy revolution – we dictate it. As a fast-growing, dynamic, global technology company, we are changing the game in the traditional energy market through advanced AI platforms and utility-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). If you are looking for a role where initiative, resourcefulness, and operational ownership meet a dynamic tech environment – and you want to be the beating heart of our HQ, driving culture while serving as a trusted partner to our executive team – your place is with us.

We are looking for a proactive, resourceful, and highly independent "right hand." Someone with a strong sense of ownership who takes tasks from zero to completion, asks the right clarifying questions upfront, and executes independently. You will be the trusted go-to person for leadership, handling complex tasks with confidence, discretion, and operational excellence.

DevOps

  • 2026-08-01

At AGEERA, we are not just keeping up with the energy revolution—we are driving it. As a dynamic, fast-growing global tech company, we are changing the rules of the traditional energy market through advanced AI platforms and large-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). We build, manage, and connect VPP and EMS infrastructure, creating a new, cost-effective, and fast-paced energy market.

This rapid growth requires a cloud and network infrastructure as resilient, scalable, and secure as the technology we deploy. If you thrive at the intersection of automation, high availability, and cutting-edge energy tech, and you want to shape the technical foundation driving Israel’s smart energy revolution, your place is with us.

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to serve as the backbone of our cloud and deployment operations. In this role, you will architect and maintain our Azure infrastructure using IaC, automate continuous deployment with GitHub Actions, and oversee container orchestration across Kubernetes clusters. You will manage complex networking and security architectures, drive observability initiatives, and enforce robust security and compliance standards (such as SOC2) to guarantee peak performance and reliable scale across all environments.
